# TONE3000 adapter provenance

Source: https://github.com/tone-3000/api/tree/cc37a11f62f0d3472a3e5a1c1274664bd3a78e47/juce/Source/T3K

MIT licensed. ToneDock modifications: app-specific storage, runtime publishable key, architecture selection, bounded HTTP bodies, redirect credential handling, OS random PKCE, callback lifetime guards and in-memory storage on Linux development hosts. Full search endpoints exist upstream but are not exposed by the free integration UI.
